marketBrief.headline: Pre-market, Nov. 11: Asia rebounds on chips, US futures firm, and bonds sit out Veterans Day
marketBrief.summary: Kospi closed up 2.6% at 5,375.36 and the Nikkei 225 rose about 1.3% after Tuesday's hot-CPI selloff, with chip stocks leading (Yonhap; TradingKey). S&P 500 futures were up about 0.9% in the European morning (investingLive). The US bond market, and the Fed, are closed for Veterans Day (SIFMA; StockTitan), so Tuesday's 4.98% 10-year close remains the last Treasury reading. Traders still price a quarter-point December hike as the base case (CNN; CNBC).
bullets: Kospi close, Nov. 11: 5,375.36, up 2.6% (Yonhap News Agency).
Nikkei 225, Asian session, Nov. 11: about 61,248.52, up about 1.3% (TradingKey); early reports differed, so treat as provisional.
US futures, European morning, Nov. 11: S&P 500 futures about +0.9%; Nasdaq futures pointed to a rebound (investingLive).
Bond market closed Nov. 11 for Veterans Day; SIFMA recommended a full close for dollar fixed income in the US, UK and Japan (SIFMA).
Tuesday's last Treasury close: 10-year 4.98%, up 10 bp; 2-year up about 17 bp (CNN Business).
December FOMC odds after CPI: 91% quarter-point hike, 9% half-point (CNN, citing CME FedWatch); CNBC cited about 13.6% for the half-point move.

calendar.event: Veterans Day: US bond market and Federal Reserve closed; stock markets open
calendar.why: SIFMA recommends a full bond market close, so no Treasury price discovery until Thursday; equities trade on futures and Asian/European prices.

calendar.event: Treasury trading resumes; weekly jobless claims; Kospi 200 monthly options expiry
calendar.why: First clean Treasury reaction to the 4.98% 10-year close and the CPI-driven hike repricing. Claims and Kospi expiry dates per Schaeffer's Research and Archynewsy.
Schaeffer's Research lists it for Friday, tentatively; check the official BLS schedule before relying on the date.
CME FedWatch pricing after CPI: quarter-point hike the base case, with a half-point move in play (CNN; CNBC).
